Ranks all Montgomery census tracts by their 2025 code-violation count from the pre-aggregated tract_counts table, joining tract names and keeping geoid last for mapping.
sql:
WITH m1 AS (
  SELECT geoid, n AS code_violation_count
  FROM fw_pg.tract_counts
  WHERE run_id = 'r_20261025_ea19d3'
    AND source = 'm1_city'
    AND grp = 'all'
)
SELECT t.name,
       COALESCE(m.code_violation_count, 0) AS code_violation_count,
       t.geoid
FROM fw_pg.tracts t
LEFT JOIN m1 m ON t.geoid = m.geoid
ORDER BY code_violation_count DESC, t.name ASC
